pages.title: Better Ink, Bigger Ideas
pages.text: Learn the ink-quality pathway through a chosen spell, not an ink shopping list.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Compare the installed forge recipes and the result’s native spell rarity. Choose a spell you can actually use; buying a loose rare ink bottle does not count.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: If the ink cannot support a spell’s first level, merely selecting it does not craft it.
